description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {3}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Cathodion. When it enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Cathodion and the Eldrazi Spawn, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
